invariants.description: Ohm law v = (u_in - u)/R and pressure-volume law u = u_0 + (q - q_0)/C
invariants.expr: np.allclose(v*R, u_in - u, rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-9*abs(u_in)) & np.allclose(u, u_0 + (q - q_0)/C, rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-9*np.max(np.abs(u)))

invariants.description: volume stays positive (q > 0) at the run point (not across the sweep: a constant forced outflow can legitimately drain the compartment below zero)
mass balance of the junction with its neighbours: q(t) - q_init = integral of ((v) - (b1__v + b2__v)), the sums taken over the connected neighbours
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(q - q_init - np.concatenate([[0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*(((v) - (b1__v + b2__v))[1:] + ((v) - (b1__v + b2__v))[:-1])*np.diff(t))]))) <= 1e-2*np.max(np.abs(q - q_init)) + 1e-6*abs(q_init)

bc_sweep.rationale: Pressures 0.5-1.5x a 12 kPa (90 mmHg) mean plus the R x flow drop, flows 0-3x a 5 L/min cardiac output, initial volume from unstressed to unstressed + 2 C x 12 kPa, u_0 0-6 kPa; R, C, q_0 at 0.5-2x. The exact solution is checked at every point.
